todos: [P1] ENV-PYTHON312-VENV-01: .venv is broken: pyvenv.cfg points to %LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\Python\Python312 (3.12.10), which is no longer installed; py -0p lists only 3.13. On 2026-09-26 .venv\Scripts\python.exe -m pytest -q failed with 'No Python at ...\Python312\python.exe'. This blocks the Sidecar tests (133), test:e2e:ingest-translate (dev Sidecar from .venv) and the PyInstaller build of sidecar.exe used by package:win and test:e2e:sidecar-ownership. .python-version and scripts/setup_dev_environment.ps1 require 3.12.x. Fix: install Python 3.12.10 (user action), run powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File ./scripts/setup_dev_environment.ps1 to recreate the venv, then run the Sidecar tests.

[P2] QWEN38-FULLTASK-01: Live full-task results of 2026-09-26 after the audit. qwen3-coder:30b run audit-20260926c: VERIFIED, 8/8 milestones, 37/50 steps, about 53 min, median prompt eval 5.0 s and median step 21 s (qwen3.8 on 2026-09-25: 57.9 s and 128 s); installs approved, build fixed after 3 failures (snapshot %USERPROFILE%\OnlyRag-Live\snapshots\*audit-20260926c*). Run audit-20260926b (before the stall fix) closed on transport_budget: Ollama sends nothing while a tool call is generated and a 1193-token write at 3.95 tok/s hit the fixed 5-minute stall limit twice (now speed-based). qwen3.8:27b: run audit-20260926 was stopped by the assistant at step 5 to fix the transcript; step 1-2 telemetry showed num_ctx 65536, 83% CPU / 17% GPU, a full 37 s prompt re-evaluation at step 2 and 1092 thinking tokens at about 2.85 tok/s (6.4 min per turn with the model's default 'medium' thinking). A direct probe (%USERPROFILE%\OnlyRag-Live\audit\cacheprobe-20260926.mjs) showed qwen3.8 does reuse its cache both when appending and when replacing the trailing message (4.4 s / 6.8 s vs 40.9 s cold), so the step-2 miss is still unexplained: suspect the rendering of the assistant thinking in history (think omitted = model default). Run audit-20260926b with the append-only transcript was stopped at the user's request before any telemetry. Next: rerun qwen3.8 with a unique ONLYRAG_LIVE_RUN, check per-turn promptEvalDurationMs from step 2 on; if misses persist, compare with modelThinkingPreferences['qwen3.8:27b']='low' or false and with thinking stripped from history. Workspaces fulltask_qwen3-coder-30b-audit-20260926, -audit-20260926b, -audit-20260926c and fulltask_qwen3-8-27b-audit-20260926, -audit-20260926b are disposable after their snapshots (cleanup tracked in LIVE-QWEN-WORKSPACE-CLEANUP-01).

[P2] RELEASE-REVERIFY-01: After the coding-agent audit (commit 890d0dd) and the 2026-09-26 cleanup, typecheck, quality:static, audit:deadcode, audit:cycles, docs:check, test:fast (275 files, 2191 tests) and test:e2e:electron, test:e2e:bundle-ux, test:e2e:settings-bootstrap, test:e2e:cold-start passed on 2026-09-26. Not rerun: Sidecar tests, test:e2e:sidecar-ownership, test:e2e:ingest-translate (loads real Ollama models), npm run package:win (release/ still holds the installer built on 2026-09-25 00:25, before the audit) and the full audit script. Needs ENV-PYTHON312-VENV-01 first; then rerun them and update the AGENTS.md verification paragraph.

[P2] AGENT-AUDIT-20260926-RESIDUALS-01: Of the residuals the coding-agent audit of 2026-09-26 left (docs/coding-agent-audit-2026-09-26.md), these were closed on 2026-09-26 with unit tests: PersistentPowerShellSession reports its real working directory and structuredCommandSafety resolves relative paths there, following cd within one command too; npx of a command missing from node_modules/.bin (and pnpm/yarn dlx, bunx) counts as network use; replace_file_content and multi_replace_file_content return the applied diff and the incremental typecheck like write_file; git_commit allows 120 s for pre-commit hooks; git_diff lists untracked files; web_search, fetch_web_content, open_in_browser and validate_visual_artifact approvals use the new 'network_request' card type; validate_visual_artifact reports a page that did not load separately from a missing Playwright runtime. Still open: (1) no background-process tool or port probe for dev servers, so a blocked server still ends as a refused command; (2) WorkspaceIncrementalTypecheck.checkWrittenFile runs ts.createProgram synchronously on the Electron main thread after every edit of a TypeScript file: move it to a worker or utility process.

[P2] AGENT-DIRECTIVE-AUTHORITY-02: The audit of 2026-09-26 made planDirectiveArbiter policy-aware, filtered policy-refused tools from the catalogue and turned the version-behind and milestone-redelivery orders into notes, but other tool-result producers still end with 'Directives: MUST' blocks (compilerDiagnosticDirective, testFailureDiagnostic, moduleResolutionDiagnostic, npmVersionNotFound, npmResolutionConflict, installVersionDowngrade, redundantWriteDetector, loopDetector interventions). Convert them to facts the arbiter consumes, add an invariant test that no two orders can reach one turn, and review the guards that never fired in 67 live snapshots for removal. This rewrites text the model reads on failure turns, so it needs a live full-task run to confirm no regression; it was left for a session where live runs are possible.

[P2] CODING-HISTORY-RESET-01: The original backup at %USERPROFILE%\OnlyRag-Backups\coding-agent-20260925-170040 has 58 valid SHA-256 copies; five source files in .onlyrag_v2\sessions are already absent. The qwen3.8 run added two history files, copied and hash-verified in coding-agent-20260925-qwen38-extra. Thus 55 session/state/tracker files remain, including 32 in the retired workspaces. The user explicitly authorized reset on 2026-09-25, but automatic execution review rejected the exact targeted Remove-Item -LiteralPath -Force operation as blocked by policy. No history file was removed. When policy permits, recheck hashes and paths, remove only verified history files, preserve code, documents, snapshots, backups and live workspaces, then verify the app starts with empty history.

[P3] TEST-AUDIT-HOME-WRITES-01: Since 2026-09-26 CapabilityPolicyAuditRepository writes to userData/logs/capability_policy_audit.json (userdata_dev/logs when headless), next to the Main log. Before that fix the test suites wrote their policy decisions into the real %USERPROFILE%\.onlyrag_v2\logs\capability_policy_audit.json (139,129 bytes on 2026-09-26, grown by that day's test runs); that file is no longer read and can be deleted by the user. Still open: AgentSessionStateRepository and SessionHistoryRepository fall back to %USERPROFILE%\.onlyrag_v2\sessions for standalone runs, so standalone-mode tests touch that real folder too; move the fallback under the userData root (with a one-time move of existing files) or inject a temp directory in those tests.

[P3] LEGACY-MIGRATIONS-01: One-time migrations from earlier layouts are still executed on every launch or read, while this is a single-user install and CODING-HISTORY-RESET-01 will empty the history anyway. Renderer: AppLayout.tsx imports localStorage onlyrag_app_settings, onlyrag_initial_setup_completed and onlyrag_language when settings.json is missing; useSessionHistory and useWorkspaceProjects push localStorage data through sessions:migrate-legacy and projects:migrate-legacy (ipcContract, secureIpcMain schemas, sessionHistoryIpc, projectRegistryIpc, SessionHistoryAppService, ProjectRegistryAppService, projectRegistryDomain merge). Main: appSettingsRepository.decodeSettingsFile accepts unversioned settings and rewrites maxToolCallSteps>=200; agentSessionStateRepository moves .onlyrag/.agent_state_*.json and .assistant/SESSION_TRACKER.md; sessionHistoryRepository moves .onlyrag/session_history.json; sidecarProcessManager migrates legacy nested data entries; restoreFileVersionEvidence accepts the pre per-file { filePath, contentHash }; plan code still recognises legacy synthetic finish milestones (agentOrchestratorApplicationClosure.ts, planAndSolveGraph.ts, agentTaskContract.ts defaults). The scripts/e2e/settingsBootstrap.mjs cases cover the localStorage path. After the history reset, confirm the local stores are on the current layout, then remove each migration with its IPC channel, tests and E2E cases, keeping the settings.json version check.

[P3] I18N-MAIN-MESSAGES-01: agent:log carries structured localized keys (shared/domain/agent/agentMainText.ts, English in src/i18n/locales/en.ts agentMain) with the Italian text as logMessage fallback. On 2026-09-26 every tool result producer was migrated through the toolLog helper of toolExecutionContracts.ts (filesystem, web, Git, recovery, process preconditions, ensure_tool, policy and visual validation), and the fixed-language orchestrator emitLog lines (final verification, workspace error, preflight, execution guard, skill router/hub, plan seeding, session timeout). Deliberately left as they are: 'Task Finished:' and the AI Agent Question marker (parsed by agentLogMessageUtils/AgentTimelineMessage), the bracket markers kept inside the localized texts ([SECURITY BLOCK] etc., used for categories) and diagnosticsToolService's 'Agent Question:'. Remaining: sessionDebtTracker markdown (SESSION_TRACKER.md is fed back to the model, so changing it needs a live run), and the Sidecar chunk prefix [Documento: ... | Sezione: ...] (requires a re-index migration).

[P3] LIVE-QWEN-WORKSPACE-CLEANUP-01: Sixteen retired Qwen workspaces (run27-run41 and tracker-rerun-01) remain under %USERPROFILE%\OnlyRag-Live: 78,588 files, 1,308,226,155 bytes, no nested reparse points or targets outside the live root. The user explicitly authorized removal on 2026-09-25, but automatic execution review rejected the exact Remove-Item -LiteralPath -Recurse -Force operation as blocked by policy. No workspace was removed. Keep audit snapshots, backups and the current qwen3.8 run; do not retry through another shell. Remove the 16 verified directories only when execution policy permits. As of 2026-09-26 the live root also holds other disposable workspaces whose runs are closed or superseded: fulltask_gpt-oss-20b-default, -tracker-rerun-01, -tracker-rerun-02, fulltask_qwen2-5-coder-7b-default, interview_qwen2-5-coder-7b, fulltask_qwen3-8-27b-tracker-20260925 and the five audit-20260926* workspaces of QWEN38-FULLTASK-01; verify each has its snapshot, then remove them too. Locally, release/ still holds the pre-audit installer of 2026-09-25 00:25 (1.55 GB exe plus win-unpacked, 4.3 GB in total); it is overwritten by the next npm run package:win (RELEASE-REVERIFY-01).
